title: DeFiStrategy
description: Describes a decentralised-finance yield or staking strategy configured by a church or individual participant in the BibleFi protocol.

strategy_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this DeFi strategy.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the DeFiStrategy schema (e.g. '1.0.0').

description.description: Optional free-text description of the strategy's purpose and mechanics.

protocol.description: The DeFi protocol this strategy interacts with.

contract_address.description: Primary smart contract address of the protocol on the target chain.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID where the protocol is deployed.

abi_uri.description: Optional URI pointing to the ABI JSON for this contract.

asset.description: The token or asset being deposited into the strategy.

contract_address.description: ERC-20 contract address. Use the zero address (0x000...000) for native ETH.

decimals.description: Number of decimal places the token uses.

coingecko_id.description: Optional CoinGecko token ID for price feed lookups.

allocation.description: How much of the available treasury balance should be allocated to this strategy.

percentage.description: Percentage of the total portfolio or treasury to allocate (0–100).

min_amount_usd.description: Optional minimum USD value that must be allocated for the strategy to activate.

max_amount_usd.description: Optional maximum USD cap on the allocation.

risk_tier.description: Risk classification of this strategy. Churches and users should select tiers aligned with their stewardship values.

expected_apy.description: Expected annual percentage yield range based on historical or projected data.

min.description: Minimum expected APY (as a percentage, e.g. 3.5 for 3.5%).

tithe_allocation.description: Optional automatic tithe distribution from yield generated by this strategy.

recipient_address.description: Wallet or contract address that receives the tithe.

rebalance_policy.description: Rules governing when and how the strategy is rebalanced.

trigger.description: 'drift' rebalances when allocation drifts beyond threshold; 'time' rebalances on a schedule; 'manual' requires explicit action.

drift_threshold_pct.description: Percentage drift from target allocation that triggers rebalancing (when trigger='drift').

active.description: Whether this strategy is currently active and accepting deposits.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this strategy was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this strategy was last updated.
